name: model-passport-lifecycle
title: Model Passport Lifecycle
description: Linear three-step chain building an SR 26-2 model passport. Step 1 registers a model-inventory record with a completeness score and proportionality tier (art-450). Step 2 backtests the model's period predicted-vs-actual outcomes against a caller-declared error tolerance (art-451). Step 3 determines the model's SR 26-2 validation status from its tier, last-validation date, and the outcome-analysis result, applying a tier-based revalidation cadence (art-453). No routing gate -- validation_status branching lives inside art-453's own output, not chain-level routing.
regulatory_refs: SR 26-2 (model risk management guidance, successor to SR 11-7)

steps.handoff: Model-inventory record with proportionality tier and completeness score. Passes to outcome-analysis backtest.
Predicted-vs-actual outcome backtest with pass/fail status against the declared breach-rate tolerance. Passes to validation-status determination.
Final SR 26-2 validation status, days-since-validation, and next-due-in-days. Final stage.
